status: Decides one thing only: whether the native d1 port on tessl/qd-metal (design doc §13.2) starts, and which career.jd_* families it may later admit. Installs nothing. Moves no Lappi gate.

what.engine: Homebrew llama.cpp 0.7.0 (build 11669, commit 620d2225c), llama-server /v1/systemone, Metal only (no -ngl 0, no CPU fallback). -np at least the questions per request.
what.backend_under_test: Vani decide.shadow 'local' (the /v1/systemone shadow wired by the parent session). Its Name, prompt variant and every reading parameter (e.g. any probability cut-off that turns a reply into answered vs abstained) are recorded and hashed in the ledger row BEFORE the first label is read for this eval. A change to any of them after that point voids this registration; the run then needs a new one.
what.primary: Vani's configured primary chain at run time (Jev), unchanged for the run and recorded in the same ledger row.
what.prompt_variant: Each choice slot's criteria are the option descriptions from the pinned fixture (Vani internal/decide/jdtriage/fixture.json version 2, sha256 0cf04ad791d67fb04bf4e1c5be9b3206f61cf356dddf0a3054c9a8b5a13be47d, mirrored at Lappi fixtures/caller/career-jd-triage-fixture.json). That is what the native port would send (design doc §4.1). A run with bare option strings measures a different prompt (3 of 12 probe choices differed, §12 M5) and does not count.

labels.tool: vani label (internal/eval), keyed by posting.Key. The latest line per key wins. A 'skip' label is not counted anywhere (internal/eval/report.go).
labels.target: 80 labelled postings with all four slots labelled (not skip).
labels.frozen: The sha256 of labels.jsonl is recorded in the ledger row at the verdict run. Relabelling a held-out posting after its verdict has been read voids this registration.

split.rule: Rank labelled postings by sha256('d1-vani-jdtriage-2026-10-18' || 0x00 || posting.Key), ascending. The first 30 are HELD OUT. All others are FIT.
split.why: The split is fixed by key before any shadow answer is read, so no answer can move a posting between the halves.
split.held_out_use: the promotion verdict below, and nothing else
split.fit_use: only the native port's calibration table (qd-calib-fit, per (choice, k+1): choice:6 is role_fit plus seniority, choice:5 is sponsorship plus work_mode). 50 fit postings give 100 rows per entry, which is ECE_MIN_SAMPLES, so the ECE gate runs. Fit postings never enter the verdict.

verdict.rule: Vani internal/eval Promotion.Verdict(), unchanged, per slot, over held-out postings the shadow was asked about.

verdicts.not promotable: shadow answered none; or shadow precision < primary precision (strictly); or shadow answered < primary answered
verdicts.promotable: otherwise. Precision is correct/answered and coverage is answered/labelled, as report.go computes them.

verdict.port_trigger: The native d1 port starts if at least one of the four families is 'promotable'. A run with 'insufficient labels' on every family is quick (rule 8) and triggers nothing.
verdict.admission: Only the promotable families may enter admitted_families (design doc §3.3, Q2), and only after the native port reproduces them (see not_claimed).

also_reported_not_deciding: the same Promotion numbers over all labelled postings (fit plus held out), marked in-sample
per-slot confusion against the labels for the shadow and the primary
the native port's ECE per calibration entry when it is later fitted (ECE_THRESHOLD 0.05), reported and not used to move this verdict
ledger_row: per-slot Promotion fields (asked, shadow answered/correct, primary answered/correct, verdict)

amendments.recorded: 2026-10-18 ~22:55 CDT, before any label exists. The parent session's read-only check at ~22:50 found no eval/ label directory, so no label had been read.
amendments.source: The parent session ('Jarvis architecture audit and unwired seams (fork)') read Vani's live config and code, and relayed the result. Not re-read by this lane.

shadow_config.name: local
shadow_config.reading_rule: no cut-off, no abstain path (decide/jev/jev.go readSlot): a choice among the options reads answered with p = confidence if present else probabilities[choice]; a missing or unknown choice, or p outside [0,1] or NaN, reads failed

primary.llm_fallback: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 (refused at check time: missing workspace ID)

amendments.shadow_config_hash_rule: sha256 of JSON.stringify(shadow_config) with the key order above (node, no whitespace). The verdict run's ledger row cites this hash.
amendments.where_recorded: Here, not as a ledger row. Vani's ledger has no event kind for it, and adding one would change Vani's contract. Lappi's ledger/ holds run rows. The verdict run writes the ledger row, citing this hash.
amendments.prompt_variant_fixed: The instructions are jdtriage's combined Prompt for every slot, not the per-family questions, with the fixture descriptions as criteria. This variant is what is measured, so a native port admitted on this verdict must render the same instructions and criteria from the pinned fixture (design doc §4.1). A per_slot shadow run is a different variant and does not count toward this verdict.
amendments.reading_consequence: The shadow has no abstain path, so its coverage is answered/asked minus failures (timeouts, unknown choices, context overflow). The verdict compares precision and coverage under that rule.
amendments.context_risk: n_ctx 8192 with unified KV holds one posting's shared state plus four question tails. An overflow is a 400, which reads failed and lowers shadow coverage. It counts as it falls; it is not retried and not excluded.
amendments.held_out_computation: vani eval today reports Promotion over all labels and has no salted held-out split (parent session's check). The held-out verdict therefore comes either from a vani feature the owner approves, or from an offline script that applies report.go's Promotion arithmetic to the 30 held-out keys. Whichever is used must first reproduce vani eval's all-labels numbers exactly, as a check that it computes the same quantity.

not_claimed: A promotable shadow verdict is necessary for the port, not sufficient for serving. The shadow is single-pass llama.cpp Q8_0 on Metal, with Vani's reading. The native port adds Lappi's derangement agreement, Lappi's calibration and its own Q8_0 kernel. Before any family is admitted, the port must pass P-L parity against the same llama.cpp file (design doc §13.2), and the held-out verdict must be re-run through the port's own path and still read promotable.
